label: Onboarding tour
summary: An onboarding tour is a structured network-building technique Maaike uses when starting with a new client or employer. It involves scheduling short introductions with individuals and asking each person to suggest two more people to meet, creating a growing network quickly. Maaike classifies it as an instance of network building.
how_maaike_uses: Maaike uses the onboarding tour specifically as a solution to the isolation problem in remote onboarding, where there are no natural opportunities for informal introductions. She describes scheduling 10-minute calls, explaining she is new, and asking each contact for two further names to speak to. The cascading effect means that within a week she has a broad network, and people start to expect her outreach because her name circulates before she arrives.
open_questions: The post gestures at the checklist being incomplete after 20+ years of experience, suggesting the onboarding tour tip itself may benefit from refinement based on others' input.
